datasets.label: Webb · near infrared
datasets.title: GN-z11 in near infrared
datasets.description: Webb's near-infrared picture of GN-z11, its light spread in depth through the spheroid of the extended component of Tacchella et al.'s published fit. The galaxy is a few native pixels of the telescope, so the volume is almost entirely the published model, with the picture giving color and brightness. Depth is modelled, not measured.
datasets.summary: A published model spheroid colored by Webb's picture of a few native pixels; depth is not measured.
